definitions.explanation: To feel unable to accept or agree with a decision, explanation, or situation. Expresses dissatisfaction based on reason — one finds something logically or emotionally unacceptable.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{納得|なっとく}がいかない。
⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{納得|なっとく}がいかなかった。
examples.english: Even after hearing the explanation, I wasn't convinced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦させられる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{納得|なっとく}がいかない⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't accept being the only one made to work overtime, so I talked to my boss about it.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{納得|なっとく}→納得：03507_nattoku⟧ (understanding, acceptance) + がいかない (doesn't come/work). A very common expression for voicing dissatisfaction or disagreement, especially when one feels something is unfair or unreasonable.

FORMS:
- ⟦{納得|なっとく}がいく→納得がいく：22296_nattokugaiku⟧ — the affirmative form: to be convinced, to find acceptable
- ⟦{納得|なっとく}→納得：03507_nattoku⟧いかない — shortened form without が, common in casual speech
- ⟦{納得|なっとく}できない→納得する：26805_nattokusuru⟧ — similar meaning using ⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{納得|なっとく}がいかない — can't accept (something specific)
- ⟦どうしても→どうしても：03476_doushitemo⟧{納得|なっとく}がいかない — absolutely can't accept it
- ⟦{納得|なっとく}→納得：03507_nattoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧いく⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧ — a convincing explanation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧ — dissatisfaction; a state/feeling, while {納得|なっとく}がいかない is about rational disagreement
- {腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちない — something doesn't sit right; more about intuitive unease
- ⟦{承知|しょうち}できない→承知する：01835_shouchisuru⟧ — cannot agree; more formal
